description: Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 (admin/admin). The Q2 recruitment audit has identified four issues in the hiring pipeline that must be resolved before the end of quarter: (1) the 'Technical Assessment' interview stage is mispositioned in the pipeline — it should appear after the 'First Interview' stage but before 'Second Interview'; (2) at least one applicant has remained in an early qualification stage with no progression for several weeks — archive this stale application; (3) the same candidate appears as an applicant across two different job openings simultaneously — the application in the earlier pipeline stage should be archived while the more progressed one is retained; (4) one candidate has accepted an offer and is at the contract stage — advance them to 'Contract Signed' and use the 'Create Employee' action to complete their hire. Browse the Recruitment module to identify each issue and resolve it.
